row.title: Prune must honour the pass's superseded verdicts
row.body: branchsweep apply() decides superseded after resolving generated files by rule, but prune() re-scanned and saw those branches as merge, so 92 superseded branches were never deleted (run 44495425705: superseded 92, branches 157). SWEEP-PRUNE-1: prune also deletes branches the latest non-dry pass recorded as superseded at the same sha; tests/foundation/test_branchsweep.py covers same and different sha.

title: Prune must honour the pass's superseded verdicts
